raw_text:
PLAN "Integrated 12-Week Plant-Based Muscle Gain Plan Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "comprehensive 12-week training with integrated cardio, meal timing, post-workout meals, cheat meals, breakfast ideas, protein powder guidance, and progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Foundation A":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Hypertrophy Foundation B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hypertrophy Foundation C":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Progress A":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 20 minutes steady state
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Hypertrophy Progress B":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 20 minutes (brisk)
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hypertrophy Progress C":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          incline_walk 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Intense Hypertrophy A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x6..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 5x6..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          running 15 minutes tempo
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Intense Hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          row ing 10 minutes (moderate)
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Intense Hypertrophy C":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 4x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          concentration_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 12 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Phase 4 A":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          rowing 12 minutes
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Phase 4 B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 20 minutes brisk
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Phase 4 C":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x15..25 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          jump_rope 8 minutes
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes

NOTES
- Protein target: 150g/day from vegan sources; distributed across 3–5 meals; post-workout meals emphasized within 60–90 minutes after training.
- Nutrition details: 1.6–2.2g/kg/day protein target; plant-based protein sources prioritized; ensure complete amino acid profile across meals; consider fortified micronutrients (B12, D, calcium, iron, zinc).
- Cardio: integrated in Phase 1–4 as listed; options include running, cycling, rowing, walking, jump rope, etc. Use closest available modality if needed.
- Post-workout meals: use the suggested high-protein vegan options; ensure 25–40g protein per meal target on training days.
- Cheat meals: optional per Phase 1–4 plan; schedule to support adherence; maintain protein targets and overall caloric balance.
- Breakfast ideas: provided high-protein vegan options; rotate to cover amino acids and keep variety.
- Protein powders: vegan options discussed with guidance on selection, timing, and dosing.
- Progression: Phase 3 features higher intensity with RPE 8; Phase 4 maintains progression and deload considerations.
- Substitutions: canonical vocabulary only; if equipment differs, substitute with safe equivalents within vocabulary while preserving movement category.
- Safety: prioritize form, recovery, sleep, hydration, and GI tolerance; adjust loads if form degrades.
